{{Short description|none}}
List of some published works of [[Nikolay Bogolyubov]] in chronological order:

==1924==
*N. N. Bogolyubov (1924). ''On the behavior of solutions of linear differential equations at infinity'' ({{langx|ru|О поведении решений линейных дифференциальных уравнений на бесконечности}}).

==1934==
*{{cite book |last= N. M. Krylov and N. N. Bogolyubov |title= On various formal expansions of non-linear mechanics |publisher= Izdat. Zagal'noukr. Akad. Nauk |year= 1934 |location=Kiev|language=uk }}

==1937==
*N. N. Bogoliubov and N. M. Krylov (1937). "La theorie generalie de la mesure dans son application a l'etude de systemes dynamiques de la mecanique non-lineaire" (in French). Ann. Math. II 38: 65–113.  Zbl. 16.86.

==1945==
*{{cite book |script-title=ru:О некоторых статистических методах в математической физике |last=Боголюбов Н. Н. |year=1945 |publisher=Изд-во АН УССР |location=Киев |language=ru }}
**{{cite book |title=On Some Statistical Methods in Mathematical Physics |last=N. N. Bogoliubov |year=1945 |publisher=Izdatelstvo AN USSR|location=Kyiv  |language=ru }}

==1946==
*N. N. Bogoliubov (1946). "Kinetic Equations" (in Russian). [[JETP|Journal of Experimental and Theoretical Physics]] '''16''' (8): 691–702. 
:*N. N. Bogoliubov (1946). "Kinetic Equations" (in English). Journal of Physics '''10''' (3): 265–274.

==1947==
*N. N. Bogoliubov, K. P. Gurov (1947). "Kinetic Equations in Quantum Mechanics" (in Russian). [[JETP|Journal of Experimental and Theoretical Physics]] '''17''' (7): 614–628. 
*N. N. Bogoliubov (1947). "К теории сверхтекучести" (in Russian). Известия АН СССР, физика, 1947, 11, № 1, 77. 
:*N. N. Bogoliubov (1947). "On the Theory of Superfluidity" (in English). Journal of Physics '''11''' (1): 23–32.

==1948==
*N. N. Bogoliubov (1948). "Equations of Hydrodynamics in Statistical Mechanics" (in Ukrainian). Sbornik Trudov Instituta Matematiki AN USSR '''10''': 41—59.

==1949==
*{{cite book |script-title=uk:Лекціï з квантовоï статистики. Питання статистичноï механіки квантових систем. |last=Боголюбов М. М. |year=1949 |location=Киïв |language=uk }}
**N. N. Bogoliubov (1967—1970): ''Lectures on Quantum Statistics. Problems of Statistical Mechanics of Quantum Systems''. New York, Gordon and Breach.

==1955==
*{{cite journal |last=Bogoliubov |first=N. N. |author2=Ostap S. Parasyuk |trans-title=A theory of multiplication of causative singular functions |journal=[[Doklady Akademii Nauk SSSR]] |volume=100 |pages=25–28 |year=1955 |script-title=ru:Теория умножения причинных исключительных функций|language=ru }}
*{{cite journal |last=Bogoliubov |first=N. N. |author2=Shirkov D. V.|trans-title=Multiplicative renormalization group in quantum field theory |journal=[[JETP]] |volume=30 |pages=77–86 |year=1955 |script-title=ru:Группа мультипликативной ренормировки в квантовой теории поля|language=ru }}

==1957==
*{{cite book |script-title=ru:Введение в теорию квантованных полей |last=Боголюбов Н. Н. |author2=Ширков Д. В. |year=1957 |publisher=Наука |location=М. |language=ru }}
**{{cite book |title=Introduction to the Theory of Quantized Field |last=N. N. Bogoliubov |author2=D. V. Shirkov |author-link2=Dmitry Shirkov  |year=1957 |publisher=Nauka |location=Moscow |language=ru }}
**{{cite book |title=Introduction to the Theory of Quantized Field |last=N. N. Bogoliubov |author2=D. V. Shirkov |author-link2=Dmitry Shirkov  |year=1959 |publisher=John Wiley & Sons Inc |isbn=0-470-08613-0 }} (1st edition)
**{{cite book |title=Introduction to the Theory of Quantized Field |last=N. N. Bogoliubov |author2=D. V. Shirkov |author-link2=Dmitry Shirkov  |year=1980 |publisher=John Wiley & Sons Inc |isbn=0-471-04223-4 }} (3rd edition)
*N. N. Bogoliubov, O. S. Parasyuk (1957). "[https://doi.org/10.1007%2FBF02392399 Uber die Multiplikation der Kausalfunktionen in der Quantentheorie der Felder]" (in German). [[Acta Mathematica]] '''97''': 227–266. {{doi|10.1007/BF02392399}}.

==1958==
*N. N. Bogoliubov (1958). ''On a New Method in the Theory of Superconductivity''. [[Journal of Experimental and Theoretical Physics]] '''34''' (1): 58.
*{{cite book |script-title=ru:Вопросы теории дисперсионных соотношений |last=Боголюбов Н. Н. |author2=Медведев Б. В. |author3=Поливанов М. К. |year=1958 |publisher=Физматгиз |location=М. |language=ru}}
:*{{cite book |title=Problems in the Theory of Dispersion Relations |last=N. N. Bogoliubov |author2=B. V. Medvedev |author3=M. K. Polivanov  |year=1958 |publisher=Institute for Advanced Study |location=Princeton }}

==1965==
*N. N. Bogolubov, [[Boris Struminsky|B. V. Struminsky]], A. N. Tavkhelidze (1965). ''On composite models in the theory of elementary particles.'' [[JINR]] Preprint D-1968, [[Dubna]].
